newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Guatemala March consumer prices rise 0.04 pct.
newsitem.headline: Guatemala March consumer prices rise 0.04 pct.

text.p: Guatemalan consumer prices rose 0.04 percent in March, compared to a rise of 1.07 percent in the same month last year, the National Statistics Institute said on Friday.
Cumulative inflation for the year was 3.46 percent at the end of March, compared with 2.86 percent a year ago, the institute said.
Year-on-year inflation was 11.51 percent on March 31, compared with year-on-year inflation at the end of March 1996 of 11.48 percent.
